concerns.text: FR-004 mandates a stratified 70/15/15 train/validation/test split based on `treatment_type`. This split can cause data leakage because records sharing the same polymer‑substrate pair (or other correlated identifiers) may appear in both training and test sets, violating the independence assumption required for valid out‑of‑sample evaluation. The methodology should instead group by polymer‑substrate pair (or another appropriate grouping variable) and perform a grouped split, or otherwise ensure that no information about a given experimental system is present in both training and evaluation folds.
